identityReview: The introduction identifies Jacob Baruch son of Judah Landau; first halakhic section begins Hilkhot Tefillah, and the last file ends nishlam Sefer Agur. This is the halakhic HaAgur, not the similarly titled lexicographic work by Samuel ben Jacob Jama.
qualityReview: All 130 files decode cleanly with no replacement/control-character flags, no internal numbering gaps, and no duplicate substantial pages. Beginning, middle and ending samples were read for coherence; historical abbreviations and possible source OCR errors are retained.
